title: Natural Q&A #8
summary: Non-lifting Q&A where NH gives his views on drugs and legalisation, relationships, heartbreak and regret, what makes a real man, judging people by their physique, vaccine mandates, religion in France and moral relativism. He also talks about his tastes in books, films and manga, his martial arts background and a cancelled natural bodybuilding show.
claims: He opposes all drugs and considers alcohol the most dangerous because it is widespread and normalised, so people do not realise they are hurting themselves
The drug label creates a mental block for most people; legalisation removes it, and consumption explodes wherever weed is legalised
A war on drugs is the wrong approach; showing people the truth about drugs works better than coercion, which only makes them attractive to rebels
Policy should be designed for people who can be influenced, not for committed users who will take drugs anyway; he applies the same reasoning to PEDs
If you are being led on in a one-sided relationship, build self-respect and strict boundaries and leave; if you are the dominant one, have the decency not to be a tyrant
To get over heartbreak, let time pass and feel it like grief; rebounds, drugs and partying are toxic coping, and lifting helps if it does not consume you
Pushing your partner to quit drugs shows care; he helped a girlfriend quit a trauma-driven weed habit, but warns it takes patience
Never have children with a drug user; you cannot build a family with someone whose priority is the drug
He will not date a woman who smokes, even though nearly every woman in Paris smokes
If someone can talk you out of your dream, you never really wanted it; a dream should be part of your identity
Teaching is the most important profession, but many teachers are trained in their subject and never in how to teach; he got silence by standing and waiting until students policed each other
Muscle Manga episodes come out once a week, about 52 a year, and every muscular character will eventually get one
The best way to help the channel is to download and archive the videos, because YouTube could delete it at any time
Modern French philosophy is poor because writers think everything has been done; fitness YouTube is stagnant the same way, with not even 40% of bodybuilding topics covered
He will never start an OnlyFans; he sees it as a form of prostitution and a fake parasocial relationship

He planned to compete in a natural bodybuilding show and film full-body workouts and full days of eating, but the show was cancelled; big channels avoid hosting shows because there is no money in natural bodybuilding

Time travel is often a crutch for bad writers; the future Trunks timeline in Dragon Ball Z does not add up, and new-world arcs are similarly risky: One Piece handled it well, Toriko was killed by it, and he fears for Hunter x Hunter
To move on from regret, forgive your past self and commit to firm decisions; if fear is the only thing holding you back from something, that is a sign you should do it
It is better to have remorse than regrets: act and maybe regret the act rather than never act, because regret is inaction and inaction is stagnation

A real man is true to himself with a strong identity, helps others develop, is kind rather than merely nice, and is willing to sacrifice himself to protect women and children because they are precious
A man should be physically active in some form, whether lifting, running or swimming; a dominant masculine spirit needs a dominant physique
Being a man means being productive, vital, having children and passing on knowledge; his grandfather built a house and has 4 kids, 10 grandkids and 5-6 great-grandchildren

He judges people by their physique: being fat signals laziness, poor impulse control and food addiction to him, but he never judges traits people cannot control like race or height, and he is happy to be proven wrong
Be a closed book; hiding your views lets you avoid being reported in hostile environments like academia and play your cards at the right moment
He rejects the idea that God saves us by grace; God can judge and guide, but the responsibility for meeting the criteria of salvation is his
He would quit or be fired rather than accept a vaccine mandate; tying work or travel to medical compliance is authoritarianism
Mecha series like Gundam, Evangelion and Gurren Lagann do not appeal to him, and he has no interest in cars
Islam is not killing Christianity in France; Christianity weakened itself after the 1905 church-state separation, atheism left a vacuum, and a strong, proud religion like Islam fills it

Islam could become France's biggest religion in about 20 years because Muslims are proud, know their texts and raise their children in the faith, while Christians stopped passing it on and hide their crosses
Star Wars Episode III is his favourite film of all time; he likes the prequels and ignores the Disney sequels
The Hobbit is his favourite Tolkien book for its looming atmosphere; he loves the Lord of the Rings films but hates the Hobbit films

He read Harry Potter at the same age as the hero, read book three around 40 times, and his mother let him skip school on release days; he suspects Rowling had a ghostwriter because she misreads the conservative-versus-progressive themes of her books
He has no interest in comics or superheroes; manga fills that space for him

He did judo for about 2 years, taekwondo 4, wrestling 4 and boxing 1; he quit judo as a small child after an unfair loss and gave up boxing for basketball partly because of a high risk of detached retinas
If he takes up a martial art later it would be jiu-jitsu, because it pairs well with lifting
Some differences are deal-breakers, like one partner firmly not wanting kids; his partner did not want kids and changed her mind, so be patient without pushing
Political differences do not matter in a relationship; he is with someone ideologically opposite and finds it enriching rather than wanting a yes-man
Ignoring red flags because you think it is your last shot at love leads to disaster; figure out who someone is before marriage or kids
France gets visibly worse every time he returns; while biking two hours a day across Paris he nearly got into knife fights and was hit by two cars that did not stop
He dislikes moral relativism because a person without firm principles can be sold anything, and if everything has the same value nothing has value
Moral relativism is a tool of intellectual dishonesty that avoids debate; ideas have a hierarchy, so say you follow stoic principles rather than calling yourself a stoic
